packages.name: cross-spawn
packages.evidence: In range: only node_modules/webpack-cli/node_modules/cross-spawn@6.0.5 (dev); OSV returns GHSA-3xgq-45jj-v275 for 6.0.5 (npm <6.0.6). node_modules/cross-spawn@7.0.6 and node_modules/execa/node_modules/cross-spawn@6.0.6 are out of range (OSV returns nothing). A condition section 2 adds applies (a build command running its parent), so the first-run 'no' is not reused. The build script 'NODE_ENV=production webpack --progress --colors -p' (package.json:7) runs webpack@5.104.1's bin, and webpack's bin/webpack.js (read as data from unpkg) runs the installed webpack-cli's bin: lines 108-113 define cli {package: 'webpack-cli', binName: 'webpack-cli'}, 79-94 runCli requires pkg.bin['webpack-cli'], 192 calls runCli(cli). The start script (package.json:8) runs it too: webpack-watch 'webpack --mode development --watch' (:10) and serve 'webpack-dev-server' (:9; webpack-dev-server@6.0.0 bin/webpack-dev-server.js:86-92,165 also runs webpack-cli). So node_modules/webpack-cli@3.3.11 (dev) is run by the build (P6) and start (P5), and following its declared dependency 'cross-spawn: 6.0.5' resolves to node_modules/webpack-cli/node_modules/cross-spawn, production whatever webpack-cli does with it at run time (the first run's 'never required by webpack-cli' is not a reason under section 2). Reading note: by a strict bin-name match the word 'webpack' names only the webpack package, and webpack declares webpack-cli only in peerDependenciesMeta (optional), not peerDependencies; under that reading the copy is still not shown dev-only (webpack-cli is not a D1 package, and D2 fails because a build command runs it), so it would be undecidable. A miss either way.
